Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 5 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: TROPICAL CYCLONE "PAOLO"
Issued at: 8:00 PM, 03 October 2025(Friday)

ORANGE WARNING LEVEL: Zambales.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING is still THREATENING.

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Bataan, Tarlac and Pampanga.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate with occasional heavy rains over Metro Manila, Rizal, Cavite, Quezon(General Nakar, Infanta), Laguna(Cabuyao, Calamba, Santa Rosa, Binan, San Pedro, Mabitac, Santa Maria) and Batangas(Agoncillo, Alitagtag, Balayan, Balete, Batangas City, Bauan, Calaca, Calatagan, Tanauan, Cuenca, Ibaan, Laurel, Lemery, Lian, Lipa, Mabini, Malvar, Mataasnakahoy, Nasugbu, San Jose, San Luis, San Nicolas, San Pascual, Santa Teresita, Taal, Talisay, Tingloy, Tuy, Santo Tomas) within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Nueva Ecija and Bulacan which may persist within 3 hours.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 11:00 PM today.
